description: This Java source file defines the ActivityA class, an Android activity demonstrating lifecycle callback methods. It manages status tracking, updates UI components, and provides intent-based navigation to other activities.

classes.name: ActivityA
classes.description: An Android activity that demonstrates and manages lifecycle callbacks, updates UI status views, and navigates to other activities.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, initializes views, and updates the status tracker on creation.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Called when the activity becomes visible; updates the status tracker.

methods.name: onRestart
methods.description: Called after the activity has been stopped and is restarting; updates the status tracker.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Called when the activity starts interacting with the user; updates the status tracker.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Called when the activity is partially obscured; updates the status tracker.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Called when the activity is no longer visible; updates the status tracker.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Called before the activity is destroyed; updates and clears the status tracker.
